About

Engineering AI that earns trust

I'm Tom Hunter, an AI Engineer. My work sits between research and production — turning models and prototypes into dependable systems with clear behavior, measurable quality, and interfaces that keep people in control.

I care about the unglamorous parts that make AI usable: honest evaluation, sensible failure modes, observable pipelines, and documentation that lets a team maintain what was built.

  • 01 Evidence over vibes. Decisions follow measurement, not demos.
  • 02 Humans in the loop. Automation should extend judgment, not replace it.
  • 03 Simple and observable. Systems should be easy to run, test, and reason about.

Focus

What I work on

Core areas of AI engineering practice — from the model to the user.

Applied Machine Learning

Designing and shipping models that solve real problems, with the data and feedback loops to keep them useful.

LLM Systems

Retrieval, tool use, and orchestration for language models — built for correctness and bounded, predictable behavior.

Evaluation & Reliability

Benchmarks, regression tests, and observability that make model quality something you can see and defend.

MLOps & Tooling

Reproducible training and deployment pipelines, local-first tooling, and clear paths from experiment to production.
